$comment: THE SITE IS PART OF THE MEASUREMENT. Both sides @teleloc here before
every scenario, so the two curves are taken over the same ground facing
the same way. Session 1 ran each side from wherever its character last
logged out; the holtburger run happened to be inside a dungeon with the
avatar pinned against a wall, reporting 7.787 m/s of intent while
Samsur was chosen by measurement, not by eye: an 8-site survey
(2026-08-11, 4.5 s run-hold at each) scored realized/intent and the z
range over the run. Samsur returned realized 7.787 vs intent 7.787
(ratio 1.000) with a 0.00 m z range over ~35 m of travel — dead flat
and completely unobstructed. Yaraq (the character's own home town, and
where session 1 happened to be) has a 0.99 m z range; Beach Fort is
unrunnable (realized 0.000, the avatar is against something and only
the heading moves); Plateau drops 7.16 m over the same run.
heading_deg becomes an explicit quaternion about Z in the @teleloc, so
the run direction is pinned too — the terrain profile depends entirely
on which way the avatar faces.
